advancement.simple_bytestorage_dimension: The Silicon Plane
Prepare to breach the boundary between physical matter and raw bytes.
No Signal Here
Try to ignite a Rift Gate outside the Silicon Rift biome. Maybe try walking closer to the router?
Entering the Matrix
Power up and ignite a Rift Gate inside a Silicon Rift biome.
Beyond the Byte
Step through a Rift Gate into the Silicon Plane dimension.
Quarter Megabyte
Craft a 256k Byte Storage Cell using resources from the Silicon Plane.
guide.simple_bytestorage_dimension.porta:
§eThe Silicon Plane§r is an optional dimension addon for high-tier storage progression.

§eHow to build the Rift Gate§r
1. Find a §bSilicon Rift§r biome in the Overworld (use a §bRift Compass§r!).
2. Build a 4x5 (up to 12x12) frame of §bSilicon Basalt§r with a §bRift Gate Core§r in the bottom row.
3. Supply §b100,000 FE§r to the Rift Gate Core.
4. Right-click the Core with a §bCorrupted Cell§r (consumed) or §bRift Resonator§r (reusable).

§eImportant§r: The gate feeds on ambient Rift resonance and §cONLY ignites inside Silicon Rift§r!
guide.simple_bytestorage_dimension.resou:
§eStage 1 Biomes§r
- §bSilicon Terraces§r: safe entry plateaus with Quantum Clusters.
- §bOptic Spirewood§r: glowing fiber spires and rich §bOptic Quartz Ore§r.
- §bBus Canyons§r: deep rifts filled with §bLiquid Coolant§r and §bBusium Ore§r.

§eHigh-Tier Rewards§r
Smelt §bRaw Busium§r into §bBusium Ingots§r, combine with §bOptic Quartz§r into §bBusium Processors§r, and pair with §bLiquid Coolant§r to craft §b256k Byte Cells§r and §b64k Portable Byte Cells§r!
advancement.simple_bytestorage_dimension: A Megabyte in Your Pocket
Craft a 1M Byte Storage Cell (1,048,576 items, no type limit).
Silicon Cartographer
Visit all 8 unique biomes of the Silicon Plane.
guide.simple_bytestorage_dimension.endga:
§eAll 8 Biomes of the Silicon Plane§r
Use §bShift + Right-click§r with the §bRift Compass§r inside the dimension to cycle between all 8 biomes:
- §bCryo-Cache Wastes§r: Cryo-Silicate Ore.
- §bCapacitor Flats§r: Fluxite Ore (64k Energy Byte Cell).
- §bCorrupted Badlands§r: Entropy Ore & Quantum Clusters.
- §bCloud Archive§r: Quantumite Ore (Quantum Core).
- §bThe Null Core§r: Matrix Ore for the ultimate §c1M Byte Storage Cell§r!
tooltip.simple_bytestorage_dimension.pha: Keep in your inventory to gain immunity to Desync in Corrupted Badlands and frost in Cryo-Cache Wastes.
